baseline_models.focus_anchor: The attribution to the Lord and to wisdom is followed immediately by the prohibition against making another deity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden divine communication, lordly cultivation, and wisdom as corrective restraint converge on the closing prohibition. Wisdom is not merely a collection of maxims; its operational edge is to block the act of assigning worship-status to a rival.

activation_trace.role: Divine impartation supplies the authorized source from which the formative wisdom proceeds.
Gradual correction and completion make the Lord's address an act of cultivation rather than bare command.
Restraint for reform gives wisdom a preventive function that checks corrupt status-making.
Changing a thing's status identifies the prohibited act as conferring a rank, not merely noticing a rival.
Worship and the object made worthy of it specify the status that must not be conferred elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: A summary label for wise counsels followed by a conventional monotheistic warning.
changed_reading.after: A formative revelation whose wisdom becomes active precisely as a restraint on manufacturing a rival object of worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressee actively makes another deity but is then passively cast, blamed, and expelled.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause reverses agency. A person who assigns elevated status to an additional object is converted into the handled object: thrown down, treated as discarded, morally exposed, and driven away.

activation_trace.role: Status-conferral supplies the initiating act by which the addressee tries to arrange the sacred order.
Addition after or beside a first marks the introduced rival as a second center.
Forceful throwing reverses the addressee from arranger into the object being moved.
The image of a cast-off thing sharpens the loss of standing produced by the reversal.
Deserved censure makes the loss of agency morally legible rather than merely physical.
Driving away completes the reversal as exclusion from the order the addressee tried to rearrange.

changed_reading.after: The punishment mirrors the offense: unauthorized status-making ends in the status-maker becoming a displaced and discarded object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A hidden mode of communication is named together with firm wisdom and an outcome of blame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus moves from concealed delivery to an ordered boundary and then to visible moral consequence. The hidden source is therefore not an exemption from accountability; its wisdom becomes inspectable in the arrangement it requires and the result of violating it.

activation_trace.role: Covert transmission supplies the initially unseen mode by which knowledge reaches the addressee.
Firm ordering turns the concealed communication into a stable and testable boundary.
Censure supplies public moral attribution at the far end of the hidden-to-visible sequence.
Exclusion gives the violated boundary an externally manifest consequence.

changed_reading.before: Revelation is authoritative because its source is hidden and divine.
changed_reading.after: Hidden divine delivery issues in an ordered, accountable boundary whose violation becomes publicly and spatially manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opens with a decisive command of exclusive service and the focus closes with a matched ban on an additional deity. This frame makes the intervening social and bodily injunctions expressions of undivided service rather than a detached ethics list.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and sovereignty anchor the exclusive center named again at the close.
Right-judging knowledge classifies the enclosed conduct as a coherent wisdom.
Exclusive worship supplies the focus-side anchor for the framing relation.
A decisive ruling gives the unit an opening boundary that the focus later seals.
Humble obedience identifies the opening demand whose exclusivity returns in the focus.

structural_cues: 17:23 opens the unit with the addressee's Lord and exclusive worship; 17:39 closes it with the same possessive Lord and a ban on an additional deity.
The ethical sequence lies between these matched statements of exclusive allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the decisive opening worship command and the matched closing prohibition; I infer a frame that makes social conduct an enactment of exclusive service. A live alternative is repetition for emphasis without a framing claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus adds a monotheistic warning after a sequence of unrelated moral rules.
changed_reading.after: The focus seals an exclusivity frame in which the whole ethical sequence is the lived form of service to one Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Parental nurture, inward knowledge, return, and protective covering expand lordly formation into a process with correction and recovery. The focus's terminal condemnation then reads as the endpoint of refused formation, not as the only mode of the Lord's relation to the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Cultivation and completion provide the focus anchor for a pedagogical reading of lordship.
Corrective restraint supplies the boundary within a process aimed at reform.
Feeding and growth render upbringing as the concrete analogue for the Lord's formative address.
Return to a place of return keeps correction and re-entry alive inside the formative mechanism.
Covering a fault and shielding its bearer supplies the restorative alternative to final exposure and expulsion.

structural_cues: 17:24 links care for parents to their earlier raising of the child.
17:25 places knowledge of inner states beside return and forgiveness before the later terminal warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, inward knowledge, return, and covering; I infer that revealed wisdom trains and repairs before it condemns. A live alternative is that these are separate merciful qualifications with no shared pedagogy.

changed_reading.before: The Lord communicates rules and threatens expulsion for breach.
changed_reading.after: The Lord cultivates through corrective wisdom, leaves a route of return and covering, and names expulsion as the terminal reversal of that formation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first regulates scattering, withholding, extension, and measured provision, then uses nearly the same prohibition-result scaffold as the focus. Making another deity becomes the terminal misallocation of allegiance: uncontrolled placement ends in an escalation from exhausted immobility to being passively cast and expelled.

activation_trace.role: Status-conferral anchors the focus as an act of placing allegiance and rank.
The worship-object identifies sacred allegiance as the resource being wrongly placed.
Being thrown supplies the focus's intensified loss of control after the misallocation.
Expulsion completes the terminal loss of place and agency.
Dissipating wealth supplies the first material model of value dispersed beyond its proper bounds.
The same status-setting verb begins the closest contextual prohibition-result parallel.
Unrestrained extension of the hand models agency pushed beyond a fitting limit.
The repeated state of deserved blame locks the contextual result formula to the focus.
Spent force supplies the earlier, less severe form of lost agency that the focus escalates.
Measured governance contrasts divine apportionment with the human overreach of assigning ultimate rank.

structural_cues: 17:29 and 17:39 share a do-not-make prohibition followed by a causal result, blame, and a terminal deprivation.
The sequence moves from giving and scattering, through constriction and extension of the hand, to the placement of sacred allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material allocation sequence and the unusually close 17:29/17:39 syntax; I infer an escalation from economic misplacement to cultic misplacement and from self-exhaustion to passive disposal. A live alternative is rhetorical reuse without a material-to-cultic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The focus warns against a theological category error.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents rival-making as the ultimate misallocation of allegiance, whose fitting reversal is total loss of agency and place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes God-given, bounded authority from human-fabricated absolute rank. Authority may be assigned to a guardian for a right, yet it remains limited by the ban on excess; the focus forbids the addressee from assigning divine status alongside God.

activation_trace.role: Delegating judgment supplies a focus-side category for authority that can be conferred without becoming absolute.
Status-conferral anchors the prohibited human act of creating an absolute rival rank.
The worship-object marks the point at which delegated standing would be inflated into divine status.
A status assigned by the divine speaker supplies the authorized counterpart to the focus's forbidden assignment.
A binding entitlement limits the delegated power to the right for which it was granted.
Taking charge supplies the guardian's functional and non-divine office.
Granted capacity and jurisdiction supply a real but derivative form of authority.
Crossing the limit prevents delegated authority from expanding into unbounded sovereignty.

structural_cues: 17:33 makes the divine speaker the agent who assigns authority; 17:39 prohibits the human addressee from assigning divine rank.
The grant in 17:33 is immediately bounded by a prohibition on excess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two uses of status-conferral, a granted jurisdiction, and an explicit limit; I infer that the focus rejects fabricated absolute jurisdiction as well as a named cult object. A live alternative confines the focus entirely to ritual worship and treats the jurisdictional resonance as secondary.

changed_reading.before: Another deity means only an additional cult object.
changed_reading.after: Another deity is also the unauthorized elevation of a derivative authority into an unbounded center of allegiance, unlike the limited authority God may grant.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covenant, comparison by measure, refusal to follow without knowledge, and repeated questioning form an accountability chain. The focus's hidden revelation is therefore paired with traceable judgment: wisdom moves from received communication through calibrated knowing to answerable action.

activation_trace.role: Concealed transmission supplies the received input whose downstream use still requires accountable ordering.
Accurate knowledge and judgment make wisdom the disciplined handling of what is received.
Firm construction supplies the reliability expected of the resulting judgment.
A secured obligation that may return for guarantee links commitment to later answerability.
Questioning makes the covenant an object of explicit audit.
Comparison between two things supplies a procedure for calibrated rather than arbitrary judgment.
Following a trace makes the transition from evidence to action the point under scrutiny.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic threshold required before following.
Repeated questioning extends audit from covenant to the faculties that generate claims and actions.

structural_cues: 17:34 and 17:36 end with the same passive state of being questioned.
17:35 places exact measure between the accountable covenant and the accountable faculties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, measure, non-following without knowledge, and repeated questioning; I infer a single accountable decision pipeline. A live alternative treats them as adjacent legal commands rather than a general account of wisdom.

changed_reading.before: Wisdom is binding because revelation supplies an unquestionable source.
changed_reading.after: Revealed wisdom joins authorized reception to measurement, knowledge, and audit, so rival status cannot be established by unsupported assertion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene stages boastful vertical overreach against earth and mountains; the focus answers with downward casting and outward expulsion. The repeated demonstrative then seals the sequence by converting the exposure of hated evil into revealed corrective wisdom.

activation_trace.role: Corrective restraint classifies the humbling reversal as part of wisdom's reforming boundary.
Downward disposal supplies the reversal of attempted height and self-assertion.
Being driven away adds horizontal exclusion to the vertical fall.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies the affective motor of the attempted self-elevation.
Piercing and rupture give the boast a downward target it cannot actually master.
A solid elevation supplies the upward scale against which human reach is exposed as small.
Vying in height makes the failed reach a bid for superior standing rather than neutral movement.
Moral badness supplies the negative material that the following wisdom diagnoses and restrains.
Repugnance to the bad establishes the Lord's evaluative stance immediately before the focus summary.

structural_cues: 17:37 moves between earth below and mountains above; 17:39 answers with casting into a lower place and expulsion.
The demonstrative in 17:38 is immediately resumed by the demonstrative opening 17:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed vertical mastery, immediate moral evaluation, and the focus's casting language; I infer a spatial agency reversal and a deictic seal. A live alternative reads the punishment as an independent sanction and the repeated demonstrative as ordinary summary cohesion.

changed_reading.before: The final punishment is spatial imagery added to a doctrinal warning.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a humbling geometry: attempted elevation and world-mastery culminate in downward disposal, while the repeated demonstrative seals that reversal as corrective wisdom.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus root to L-M-M rather than the ordinary sense of blame. It remains anchored to word 17, its repetition in 17:29, and its pairing with casting and expulsion, but downstream prose should present it only as a secondary morphological shadow and never replace the ordinary censure reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word at focus index 17 within the terminal pair of blame and expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Gathering what was dispersed supplies an exploratory image of consequences converging on the status-maker.
A descending affliction gives the blame-word an exploratory shadow of an enveloping condition.
Casting supplies the directional event through which the converging condition takes effect.
The earlier repeated blame-word places the same affliction-shadow beside exhaustion, giving the outlier a contextual foothold.
Scattering supplies the reversible motion whose opposite is consequences gathering back upon the actor.

changed_reading.before: Blame is solely verbal or social censure after punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the blame-word also casts a shadow of dispersed acts gathering back as an affliction that closes in during casting and expulsion.

strongest_changes: The exact 17:29 and 17:39 prohibition-result parallel recasts rival-making as the terminal form of misallocation and loss of agency.
The bounded grant of authority in 17:33 distinguishes derivative jurisdiction from the fabricated absolute rank prohibited in the focus.
The accountability sequence in 17:34-36 turns wisdom into a chain of obligation, measure, knowledge, and questioning rather than authority by assertion alone.
summary.what_was_special: The focus acts as a deictic seal: it gathers the ethical sequence under revealed wisdom while converting repeated motifs of making, measure, blame, height, and restraint into a final reversal of agency.
remaining_uncertainties: The economic-to-cultic movement may be a deliberate semantic escalation or only a strong rhetorical parallel.
The jurisdictional resonance of another deity may be coextensive with worship or only a contextual extension of it.
The L-M-M split-root outlier is intentionally exploratory and must not displace the ordinary blame reading.
